component.name: Zarya
component.summary: Runs your system and flatpak updates at login

description.p: Zarya is a small GTK4 app that refreshes and dist-upgrades your system packages (via zypper) and updates your flatpaks, showing live output in a window. Run it by hand, or enable "Start at login" so it runs itself once a day, first thing.

ul.li: Runs zypper refresh + dist-upgrade with a single graphical password prompt
Skips re-running if it already updated today
